svg.title: One observer architecture, two physical branches
svg.desc: A source-selected twelve-port carrier federation settles a public normal form. Authenticated read-from provenance generates a finite event poset and its exact longest authenticated-parent-chain source height, while every finite strict partial order compiles exactly into the abstract provenance grammar. Independently, a real axis and the exact rank-three source Gram quotient define a four-dimensional ambient carrier with Lorentz signature plus-minus-minus-minus, and every unit source direction gives a future-null direction. Every finite log has an auxiliary injective forward-causal placement in that carrier. The enumeration is not source-selected and need not reflect order. For a candidate placement, an edge-speed bound proves the forward order-to-cone implication, while equal-height spatial separation and strict spacelikeness of increasing-height incomparable pairs imply converse support, an exact order embedding, and interval preservation. All 30 Hasse links of the frozen source control carry source-native carrier-local port/null-ray decorations in a hidden reference presentation. Used-port ranks are 2, 1 and 2 and pooled rank is non-invariant, so no local rank-three cone or frame gluing follows. Nested geometry-seeded Poisson 3+1 controls recompile carrier and order exactly through provenance. These prove link-decoration and grammar compatibility, not physical selection. A separate minimal tensor theorem uses nine supplied source-direction balances, Ward and Bianchi conservation, and connectedness to derive all-null balance and one finite Einstein-form ambiguity. Provenance supplies none of the tensor fields, discrete step, or balance laws. A physical effective manifold requires signal-causal agreement, Poisson/count-to-volume calibration, source-selected refinement convergence, manifoldlikeness, independent dimension tests, and stable topology. Smooth Einstein dynamics additionally requires a same-family tensor-curvature or continuum null-balance identification, physical stress, coupling, vacuum, and scale; scalar-curvature convergence alone is only a diagnostic. A separate physical bridge leads to the icosahedral current and Standard Model branch. Evidence custody: evidence/source_causal_history_family/, evidence/causet_likeness/, and evidence/local_domain/.

g.text: schedule-independent only under the consensus receipts
causal-poset grammar + 1+3 precursor; exact compatibility controls
any finite strict poset compiles; height = longest parent chain; ℝ ⊕ rank-3 → dim 4
auxiliary order→cone; exact candidate needs edge speed + two separation checks
9 balances → Einstein shape on a separate supplied tensor interface
route identity, attachment, and inhabited-tower receipts are required
